items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Tim used to like to play him, he used to always ask him to play the blues... Whoever went like that, there was always somebody asking shots to play something

ctx.x: Plays the lead in Careless Love. See, he was fairly good and smooth. And ragtime, he had a touch, you know, he had a real good touch on the corner. He was one of them, Tim used to like to play him, he used to always ask him to play the blues, play Kellers Love and all that. Whoever went like that, there was always somebody asking shots to play something, you see. And he played Kellers Love. And he was very good.
And I wonder, did you make more records after that? No.
